description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Awoken Turks Recruit], [Damage Cap +10000], [Instant Cast 1], [Linked Materia Mode (Fire, Lightning)] and [Rookie Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Turks Recruit
description.text: Fire and Lightning abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire and Lightning abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Linked Materia Mode (Fire, Lightning)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire] after using a Fire ability, grants [Attach Lightning] after using a Lightning ability

description.name: Rookie Mode
description.text: Casts Turks Flurry after another ally uses a Fire or Lightning ability, removed after triggering six times
